meta.generatedFrom: TypeScript (the parity contract — never regenerate from Rust)
meta.description: The exported factory functions. createGameRng pins sequence 0; createRngStreams derives four child seeds from a master at sequence 0 and assigns sequences 1..4; forkRng consumes exactly ONE nextInt from the parent.
notes: createGameRng(seed) is NOT the same stream as new GameRng(seed) — the factory passes sequence 0, the constructor defaults to 1.
forkRng advancing the parent by one draw is observable; parentNextAfterFork records it.
meta.floatEncoding: bits = raw IEEE-754 f64, big-endian, 16 uppercase hex digits. dec = shortest round-trip decimal, informational only.
meta.nanPolicy: Every NaN is recorded as 7FF8000000000000 (the pattern of Rust f64::NAN). V8 does not emit a stable NaN sign/payload, so only NaN-ness is contractual — compare NaN results with is_nan(), not with bits.
